summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the str-mixin enum EndpointResolverBuiltins with the eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: the STS predicate _should_set_global_sts_endpoint now accepts a None endpoint config (no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults(region_name, service_name, s3_config, endpoint_bridge, client_endpoint_url, legacy_endpoint_url), which uses the bridge's FIPS variant lookup, DualStack lookup, the existing S3 and STS predicates, and returns a mapping keyed by the enum members. Absent SDK::Endpoint is returned as None. Import added as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py, test_client.py, and test_regions.py pass (415 tests). Nothing committed. One pre-existing line in args.py (~line 315) exceeds 79 columns and was left unchanged.
